title: The adapter module is the sole importer of the SMTP client and every credential is sourced through the configured reference
asA: operator scanning the deployed application for boundary hygiene
iWant: the SMTP transport surface confined to the adapter module and every secret sourced from configuration
soThat: a code-path leak of the SMTP credential cannot happen from outside the adapter and no secret material is embedded in the shipped code

acceptanceCriteria.description: A source-tree import-graph scan of the deployed application finds the SMTP client library imported from exactly one module: the adapter module. No other module of the application imports the SMTP client library.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project that composed this blueprint and realised TAC-401 against an SMTP client library
acceptanceCriteria.when: an import-graph scan enumerates every module of the application that imports the SMTP client library
acceptanceCriteria.then: the scan returns exactly one module and that module is the adapter module

acceptanceCriteria.description: The send adapter (TAC-401) resolves the SMTP host, username, password and the from-address through the project's configured secret-reference resolver at boot; no literal for any of these four values appears in the send adapter's own source. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the four placeholder references (RESEND_SMTP_HOST, RESEND_SMTP_USERNAME, RESEND_SMTP_PASSWORD, RESEND_VERIFIED_SENDER_ADDRESS) on the elicited slots; the AC substitutes those names.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the send-adapter module source and the four configuration references RESEND_SMTP_HOST, RESEND_SMTP_USERNAME, RESEND_SMTP_PASSWORD, RESEND_VERIFIED_SENDER_ADDRESS
acceptanceCriteria.when: the send adapter source is scanned for literals and the reference names are cross-checked against the resolver invocation shape at TAC-401.responsibilities[8]
acceptanceCriteria.then: the send adapter source contains no literal for any of the four values, and each of the four reference names appears exactly at the resolver invocation site the send adapter calls at boot

acceptanceCriteria.description: The webhook verifier (TAC-402) resolves the webhook signing secret through the project's configured secret-reference resolver at boot; no literal for the webhook secret appears in the verifier's own source. The send adapter does not carry the webhook secret. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the RESEND_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET placeholder reference on the verifier's elicited slot; the AC substitutes that name.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the webhook-verifier module source and the reference RESEND_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET
acceptanceCriteria.when: the verifier source is scanned for literals and the reference name is cross-checked against the resolver invocation shape at TAC-402.responsibilities[5]; the send adapter's source is scanned to confirm the webhook secret name does NOT appear there
acceptanceCriteria.then: the verifier source contains no literal for the webhook secret, RESEND_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET appears exactly at the verifier's resolver invocation site, and the send adapter's source does not reference RESEND_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET at all
